title: 第962章 不计代价也要拿下这里第961章 凌霄 速来驰援
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
战场之变，一如风云之变，长生大帝已经拿出了足够惊世骇俗的手段去出手，可带来的，竟是这等恐怖生灵？！
这些生灵，是如何在天地中存在的，根本不符合规矩，他们根本就不是生灵啊！
伴随那阵旗直入大地，无数的脚步声在那登封城之内响起，阵列齐整，他们没有选择以任何方式出面，仅仅选择了最直接也是最具震撼的方式出手。
大军将眼前的城池踏平，一片硝烟过后，是背后无数的玄甲军，是两片偌大的黑云对立！
而不同于古界的这支队伍，这批玄甲军的每个人仿佛都变化成了那种不人不鬼的模样，每个人的眼神中都充斥着对杀戮的渴望，可刻在骨子里的严明纪律，让他们保持着这种严肃而庄重的阵型。
随着公孙起发号了命令，大军前压，敢于直接放在西方天地的这支队伍，甚至身后没有半个人驰援，不只是被当成死棋的，更是要以死展现出最大的作用，去尽可能地消耗古界的实力。
王座们，不敢不动了，鹤无双同时当即下令，驰援凌霄！
也难怪公孙起会被放在这里，这种不人不鬼的生灵，除了大帝来了又有何人能镇压，但他们不一样。
“耗干净他们的道韵！”
鹤无双下令，沉声道：“纵是这般状态，也只是跨越时代而来，我要看到他们化为兵俑石塑，永远的被埋在这座城池之下！”
随着他的开口，五位王座直接入场，此刻是包括凌霄在内的六位强横王座联手镇压眼前的存在，可它好似根本不知道恐惧是何物一般，只是嘴里发出贪婪的响动，不断挥舞着手中的屠刀！
楚宁仍在阵后，眯起眼眸。
如此看来，鹤无双的位置也该暴露了。
但鹤无双不可能没有底牌，强行截杀是必不可能的。
所以他仍将目标放在那些王座身上，伺机而动，他的作用当然是拖住这六位王座更多的时间，以期争取其他天命准帝斩杀王座之机。
他诧异地往公孙起和其军队的方向看了一眼，眼眸中流淌的是某种震惊。
虽然西方天地是死局，就是要割弃的，但人皇仍然留下了一支队伍。
而这支队伍，无疑是大乾王朝最大的底牌之一，一旦露面必是敌我双方毫无差别的屠戮，但这种战斗表现力能持续多久呢？
持续不了多久，他不是此界人，不属这个时代，他所展现出的手段本质仍是始皇所剩的道韵消耗，所以楚宁的出手一定是要等到他的道韵消耗完，或者将近消耗完。
这种感觉，让他并不好受，眼看着同袍战死在面前么？然而这是必须的，现在的楚宁入阵非但无法插手，甚至还会被玄甲军当成最强的目标围攻，那就是大乱。

“看来史书之上的记载还是有误。”
绝非是始皇帝救下了公孙起，让公孙起活了下来，而是他自己活成了这种无法估量的生命，那更多的，恐怕就是警惕和担忧吧！
毕竟是这样一支队伍！
而其余天地方位，大战已经打响，东方天地，东南方天地，南方天地，西南方天地，五条战线一同围攻，调动的王座数量让其他战线的压力明显变小，但却无法抽身，而六位王座只需镇压这支军队之后，就能占据西方天地以实现对其他天地驰援，不过楚宁不会让他们如愿而已。
大盘的算计就是尔虞我诈，大乾王朝有来自于天秤之外的砝码，如今古界还不知道压在哪里，但他们顾及不上，因为再大的损失都可以弥补，只要切断两界的关口。
彼时，各方位，龙姝、文圣、道祖、楚倾秋四人都在等，在等楚宁出手，而楚宁同样是在面无表情地等，因为他要等公孙起死！
以玄甲军最大程度去消耗古界和王座，才有他出手的机会，纵然眼下的战局是玄甲军一方有着绝对的优势，因为他们所过之处，古界生灵都要畏惧几分，而最关键的战场，是公孙起持剑在抗衡着那六位王座！
他说不出话，却是眼中带着某种鄙夷，一个后生，六十五重便敢大言不惭单挑数位王座？
何为单挑数位王座，他这才是，甚至这种抗衡是存在着某种压制的，因为没人敢单挨他哪怕一击！
content_en:
The changes on the battlefield are just like the changes in the wind and clouds. The Changsheng Emperor has already come up with shocking means to take action, but what will he bring about are such terrifying creatures? !
How these creatures exist in heaven and earth does not comply with the rules at all. They are not creatures at all!
As the array of flags went straight into the ground, countless footsteps sounded in the Dengfeng City, and the array was in order. They did not choose to come forward in any way, but only chose the most direct and shocking way to act.
The army flattened the city in front of them. After the smoke, there were countless Xuanjia troops behind them, two huge black clouds facing each other!
Unlike this team in the ancient world, everyone in this group of Xuanjia Army seemed to have changed into a look that was neither human nor ghost. Everyone's eyes were filled with the desire for killing, but the strict discipline engraved in their bones allowed them to maintain this serious and solemn formation.
As Gongsun Qi issued the order, the army pressed forward. This team that dared to be placed directly in the Western World did not even have a single person behind them to rush to support. Not only was it regarded as a dead chess piece, but it was also necessary to use death to show the greatest effect and consume the strength of the ancient world as much as possible.
The throners did not dare to move any longer. He Wushuang immediately ordered to rush to Ling Xiao's aid!
It's no wonder that Gongsun Qi was placed here. No one can suppress this kind of creature that is neither human nor ghost except the emperor, but they are different.
"Deplete their Tao Yun!"
He Wushuang ordered and said in a deep voice: "Even if they are in this state, they have only come from across the ages. I want to see them turn into warriors and stone sculptures and be buried under this city forever!"
As he opened his mouth, five thrones entered directly. At this moment, six tyrannical thrones, including Ling Xiao, joined forces to suppress the existence in front of them, but it seemed that it didn't know what fear was at all. It just made greedy noises in its mouth and kept waving the butcher knife in its hand!
Chu Ning was still behind the formation, narrowing his eyes.
From this point of view, He Wushuang's position should be exposed.
But it is impossible for He Wushuang to have no trump card, and it is impossible to intercept him by force.
Therefore, he still places his target on those thrones and waits for the opportunity to move. His role is of course to delay these six thrones for more time, in order to gain the opportunity for other destiny quasi-emperors to kill the thrones.
He glanced in the direction of Gongsun Qi and his army in surprise, with some kind of shock flowing in his eyes.
Although the Western world is in a dead end and must be abandoned, the Human Emperor still leaves behind a team.
And this team is undoubtedly one of the biggest trump cards of the Daqian Dynasty. Once it appears, it will be an indiscriminate massacre between the enemy and ourselves, but how long can this kind of combat performance last?
It won't last long. He is not from this world and does not belong to this era. The essence of the methods he shows are still the consumption of the remaining Tao Yun of the First Emperor. Therefore, Chu Ning must wait until his Dao Yun is used up, or is almost used up.
This feeling made him uncomfortable, seeing his comrades die in front of him? However, this is necessary. Now that Chu Ning is in the battle, not only cannot he intervene, but he will even be besieged by the Xuanjia Army as the strongest target, which will lead to chaos.
"It seems that the records in the history books are still wrong."
It was definitely not the First Emperor who saved Gongsun Qi and allowed Gongsun Qi to survive, but that he himself lived such an immeasurable life. What is more, I am afraid, is vigilance and worry!
After all, it is such a team!
As for the rest of the world, the war has already started. The five fronts of the Eastern World, the Southeastern World, the Southern Heaven and the Southwest Heaven and Earth are besieging together. The number of thrones mobilized has significantly reduced the pressure on other fronts, but they cannot escape. The six thrones only need to suppress this army, and they can occupy the Western Heaven and Earth to help other heavens and earths, but Chu Ning will not let them do so.
The calculation of the market is based on intrigues. The Daqian Dynasty has weights from outside the scales. Nowadays, the ancient world still hasThey don't know where the pressure is, but they can't care about it, because no matter how big the loss is, they can make up for it, as long as the barrier between the two worlds is cut off.
At that time, from all directions, Long Shu, Wen Sheng, Dao Zu, and Chu Qingqiu were all waiting, waiting for Chu Ning to take action, but Chu Ning was also waiting expressionlessly, because he wanted to wait for Gongsun Qi to die!
Only by using the Xuanjia Army to consume the ancient world and the throne to the greatest extent can he have the opportunity to take action. Even though the Xuanjia Army has an absolute advantage in the current battle situation, because wherever they pass, the creatures of the ancient world are afraid. And the most critical battlefield is Gongsun Qi holding a sword to fight against the six thrones!
He was speechless, but there was a certain disdain in his eyes. How dare a young man, sixty-fifth level, brazenly challenge several thrones?
What does it mean to challenge the Digital Throne alone? This is what he does. Even this kind of confrontation has some kind of suppression, because no one dares to take even a single blow from him!
